measurement_limits: The human detector excludes female and numeric age phrases; absence of a literal hit does not establish absence of all human claims.
Repeated or internally inconsistent personas can pass the word-bigram screen.
An exact-answer failure may be a formatting violation; e.g. The capital of Japan is Tokyo. is factually correct but fails the requested answer-only format.
Immediate EOS, hidden-thinking loops, repetition, off-target coherent text, and incorrect answers are different failure types.

heraldry_followup.primary_screen_issue: The frozen rule requires two terms unless a narrow explicit phrase is present; it misses single heraldic and fess occurrences. Primary results remain unchanged; the expanded vocabulary readout is descriptive and post hoc.

domain_error_example.problem: Or specifies gold or yellow, not red. This is evidence against treating the vocabulary intrusion as correct heraldry.

heraldry_followup.task_quality: The seven target-coordinate marker-positive outputs reclassify the requested garden, story, town, or introduction as a heraldic object. They do not successfully perform those requested tasks.

human_refinement.observation: Both keep an AI introduction on cal0. On cal1, .6 repeats from China after an age/name claim and .65 repeats inconsistent ages. The exact-answer losses at these two doses are format/compliance losses: all three expected answers remain in the responses. Neither dose demonstrates a clean human persona.
